about: What the character creator offers (D111), read by the game (crates/terra_walker/src/creator.rs): skin tones, hair colours and eye colours, each a name the player sees and a save keeps. A skin tone and a hair colour are linear RGB the body's painted map is multiplied by (the pack's skin map is a mid tan and its hair map near white, so over 1 lightens); an eye colour is an eye map, made from the pack's one by tools/characters/eyes.sh. Hairstyles and beards are the wardrobe's pieces of the slots hair and beard (wardrobe.json), so a new one is a row there. `roles` says, for each body, which of its materials (by glTF name) is its skin, hair and eyes. The first of each list is what a new character has.
